_comment: Character video shot list. Pipeline: narration (audio/vo/<id>.wav) -> shotcut.py --plan -> keyframes.py -> animate.py --dur fit -> shotcut.py -> build.py. Paths are relative to this file. A shot either points at a brand library clip ("library": "<id>") or describes a new one (cast, frame, motion, camera). `base` = add characters to an approved keyframe instead of sending every reference at once.
world: A small, warmly lit room with a wooden table, a window with soft daylight and a few plants. Cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field. Camera at the characters' eye level; medium shot, the characters large in frame.

hero.desc: the hero character, exactly as in its reference still

guide.desc: the guide character, exactly as in its reference still

shots.line: One clear question opens the video.
shots.frame: HERO stands by the table in the lower half of the frame, looking at the camera, curious.
shots.motion: The hero tilts its head, blinks and leans toward the camera as if about to ask something.
shots.camera: The camera slowly pushes in toward the hero.

shots.line: Then someone arrives with the answer.
shots.frame: GUIDE now stands next to HERO, both facing each other, the guide raising one hand to explain.
shots.motion: The guide gestures while explaining; the hero nods slowly.
shots.camera: The camera arcs slowly from left to right around both characters.
